name: Ross Stores, Inc.
summary: Ross Stores, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates off-price retail apparel and home fashion stores under the Ross Dress for Less and dd's DISCOUNTS brands in the United States. The company offers designer apparel, accessories, footwear, and home-fashioned products for the entire family. It sells its products to middle income households and households with lower to more moderate incomes. Ross Stores, Inc. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Dublin, California.
leadership_credibility: Led by Mr. James G. Conroy (CEO & Director). Directing strategic execution, operational scaling, and capital allocation for Ross Stores, Inc..
insider_alignment: Insiders hold approximately 2.14% of outstanding shares.
moat_type: Proprietary IP, Customer Relationships & Market Presence
moat_durability: Competitive position sustained by product quality and distribution scale.
moat_intangibles: Brand Equity & Trademarks: Iconic consumer brand recognition and sticky direct-to-consumer ecosystem affinity.
moat_network_effects: Omnichannel Scale & Customer Loyalty: Dense retail distribution footprint and high repeat transaction volume.
moat_pricing_power: Scale & Volume Cost Advantage: Operating margins supported by high-volume throughput and lean unit cost structure (33.4% gross margin).
tam_description: Global consumer discretionary spend, retail e-commerce, mobility, and leisure entertainment expanding at ~6.0% CAGR.
tam_sanity_check: Penetration Runway: Current revenue of $24.51B represents ~0.5% market penetration, leaving massive headroom for top-line expansion.
tam_optionality: Omnichannel retail innovation, emerging market consumer growth, and loyalty monetization.
